author: Gemma Easton
content: Highly recommend. Booked for my daughter's birthday party in May but high winds were forecast for the day. Communication was excellent on the lead up with regards to the weather. Unfortunately, an assessment in the garden the day of the party confirmed the winds were too high and it was unsafe for the bouncy castle - we resorted to a good old house party. Rebooked for today and invited all her friends again. Punctual, professional and pleasant to deal with. Kids had a ball and woukld definitely book USB events again. 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
